text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle with SO-AWESOME 
rivals— the MEGA-STRONG Degi-tan claimed 
victory, only to be welcomed by the 
passionate gazes of the local girls...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Did I do something again?!" Surrounded by 
the heroines, a bewildered Digi-tan 
witnesses the explosive birth of an 
Umamusume harem?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Such pure charm has Digi-tan on the verge 
of passing out from sheer bliss!! Oh gosh, 
I give up, you wonderful Umamusume!! And 
by 'give up', I mean I'm running miles 
with joy! Miles, I say!!
